name: SuperTokens

evidence.hosted: F02: SuperTokens Cloud runs Core and its database; F05: vendor operates Core infrastructure
evidence.server: F02: Apache self-hosted Core on your own infrastructure; F35: Docker or VM deployment documented

line: App authentication service with Cloud and self-hosted options.

free.text: Free below 5,000 MAU; published threshold conflicts

cells.freeUsers: Cloud says under 5,000 MAU; self-host core free

mau.math: Below 5,000 users, the Cloud authentication base is $0 a month. App hosting and other operating costs are extra.
10,000 users at $0.02 each is $200 a month, using the main pricing calculator. Another source disagrees on where the free limit sits.
50,000 users at $0.02 each is $1,000 a month, using the main pricing calculator.
100,000 users at $0.02 each is $2,000 a month, using the main pricing calculator.
